title: Ibrahim bin al-Mahdi and the Barber-Surgeon
logline: A prince on the run with a price on his head is sheltered by a poor barber who refuses the reward, by a soldier's wife who hides him from her own husband, and betrayed by a woman who owed him her freedom; the caliph pardons him and pays each one back in kind.
moral: Loyalty and kindness are repaid, and betrayal for money is punished; mercy ends a quarrel better than revenge.
tone: Light comic suspense (a hunted man who sees a reward poster in every face) that warms into trust and ends in a generous court scene. The disguise and the soldier supply the laughs; the barber and the pardon supply the heart.

beats.summary: Uncle on the throne, nephew the caliph walks in: the quarrel over rule.
Ibrahim loses, falls off the throne and runs to hide in Baghdad.
A huge reward is posted; every passer-by is now a danger.
He finds he is hiding against his own reward poster.
Fed by the barber, he imagines being sold.
The feared object from the chest is a lute.
The barber knows exactly who he is.
He will not betray him: the reward notice is torn up; they sing.
Recognised in his disguise, he shoves the soldier at the bridge and flees.
The woman hiding him is the soldier's wife; she protects him anyway.
The woman he once freed sells him for the reward.
He confesses and asks pardon; the court splits between death and mercy.
The caliph chooses pardon and restores him.
The soldier is made a barber's apprentice.
The loyal barber receives house, robe of honour and yearly pay.

scenes.summary: The quarrel over the throne in one picture: uncle Ibrahim sits on the throne, his nephew the caliph walks in with two guards, Ibrahim loses his seat and runs.

scenes.summary: A woman hides him behind a curtain. The door opens and in limps the same soldier, soaked: her husband. She still keeps the secret for three days.

Wife in red and yellow in the middle between husband (left) and curtain (right) from 84.7 on: she is literally the wall between them.

scenes.summary: At dusk he moves to the house of a woman he once set free. She welcomes him, sees the reward notice, and fetches the guards.

scenes.summary: Ibrahim is marched before the caliph still dressed as a woman. He kneels, admits it and asks pardon. The court splits: one vizier for death, one for mercy.

Ibrahim kneels at x 400 on the red runner. vizierRed at x 200 (left of Ibrahim), vizierBlue at x 560 (right of him, below the dais edge). Their picture balloons sit at (200, 330) and (540, 330), 200 x 150 each, so the caliph's eye line passes between them. Guards at x 80 and x 950.

actions.action: Two guards march a veiled green figure in through the door arch.

actions.action: Head down, hands together in front; the viziers turn to look.
actions.acting: Gaze at the floor [0,1], shoulders in; viziers' heads turn one after the other.

actions.acting: Chin gesture, lid 0.4, one brow raised; he leans forward slowly.

actions.action: A guard lifts the veil with two fingers: the black beard springs out.

actions.action: The court laughs (HA HA!). Ma'mun hides a smile behind his hand.

actions.action: Sinks to his knees.

actions.action: Raises clasped hands.

actions.action: Points down at Ibrahim, scowling.

actions.acting: Balloon pops on with a hard edge; Ibrahim sq 0.94, eyes to the balloon.

actions.action: Steps forward with open palms.
actions.acting: palmsUp, brow -0.5, a small bow to the throne.

actions.acting: Caliph: pupils only (saccades). Ibrahim: whole head, 2 frames behind the caliph.

scenes.summary: The caliph chooses pardon, lifts his uncle up and gives him back his own clothes and goods. Then he asks for the whole story; a round inset replays the three helpers and he decides to reward kindness and punish betrayal.

actions.action: Shuts his eyes; two fingers drum on the arm rest. The sword and the heart hang in the air.
actions.acting: The longest stillness of the film: lid 1, only the fingers (2 px) and the lamp flames move for 1.6 s.

actions.action: Opens his eyes and stands.
actions.acting: Eyes first, a breath (sq 1.03), then sit 1 to 0.

actions.action: The heart balloon swells and the sword balloon bursts. Ma'mun opens his arms.
actions.acting: Heart to 1.4x with a pulse; sword balloon pops into 6 dots; vizierRed's shoulders drop, vizierBlue beams.

actions.action: Steps down and lifts Ibrahim to his feet by both hands. Label: UNCLE!
actions.acting: Ibrahim kneel 1 to 0 with the pull (lurch), wet eyes, mouth trembling into a smile.

actions.action: Sits on the step and starts to tell it with his hands.
actions.acting: Storyteller's hands: one up, both wide; talk 0.6.

actions.action: The inset shows the barber's room.
actions.acting: Both men lean toward it.

actions.action: In the inset the barber tears the reward notice and sings; a green tick stamps the rim.
actions.acting: Ma'mun nods slowly, hand to beard (moustache gesture).
actions.library: inset; tick stamp with settleTo; PERSON_HANDS.moustache

actions.action: In the inset the soldier's wife stands in front of the curtain with her hush hand; second green tick.
actions.acting: Ma'mun's brows go up: impressed. Ibrahim holds his heart.

actions.action: In the inset the old woman with coin eyes points at her door.
actions.acting: Ibrahim's telling hands drop into his lap; he looks away from the inset.

actions.action: A red X stamps the rim. Ma'mun's brow comes down.
actions.acting: X lands hard (2 frame squash); Ma'mun brow 0.8, mouth set.

actions.action: The inset irises shut. He stands.
actions.acting: Iris closes on the X; he rises in one move, robe settling late.

actions.action: One finger up: decided.
actions.acting: pointUp with overshoot; everyone in the hall looks at the finger.

scenes.summary: Four judgments in a row, each one a small comic or warm picture: the informer loses the reward, the soldier is turned into a barber's apprentice, his clever wife is honoured, and the loyal barber gets the soldier's house, a robe of honour and a yearly purse.

camera.notes: CAM: 140.6 {x:480,y:670,zoom:1.2}. Each person judged stands on the same mark at x 380; the camera pushes in a little on each (zoom 1.45 centred x 470) and relaxes between. 152.8 pan left to the door {x:300} for the barber's entrance, back to {x:480,y:650,zoom:1.4} by 155.3.

scenes.composition: Ma'mun stands on the dais at x 700 (not seated: he is acting). Ibrahim stands at x 580 beside him as witness. The judged person is at x 380. People already judged collect at the left wall x 90..240 (soldier, wife) and watch, so the group grows toward the final tableau.

actions.action: Guards bring the old woman in; she is hugging a reward purse.
actions.acting: She walks fast and pleased, expecting praise.

actions.action: She sees Ibrahim standing free beside the caliph in his own robes, and slides the purse behind her back.

actions.action: Points at her; a red X stamps above her; a guard takes the purse back.
actions.acting: Straight arm; her hands follow the purse for a moment and close on air.

actions.action: She looks up at Ibrahim, cannot hold his eyes, drops her head and is led out.

actions.action: His wife steps forward and bows.
actions.acting: Calm, eyes down then up.

actions.action: A gold necklace is put over her head; it glints.
actions.acting: She touches it with her fingertips; goldGlow 0.5.

actions.action: She taps her temple once and winks at Ibrahim. Her husband looks at her, at Ibrahim, at the necklace: the coin drops.

actions.action: Everyone turns to the door: the barber comes in shyly, lute on his back, cap in his hands.
actions.acting: Small steps, eyes wide at the hall, tip 0.08; heads turn in a wave from left to right.

actions.action: Opens a hand toward the barber.
actions.acting: Smile, palm up, gaze on the barber.

actions.acting: Soldier arm out, face turned away, lid 0.6; barber takes the key with two fingers, embarrassed.

actions.acting: Coins stack in 0.5 s; he hops back a step.

actions.action: Two more piles drop beside it, each under a small sun: EVERY YEAR.
actions.acting: Barber hands to cheeks; Ibrahim laughs.

scenes.summary: The ordeal is over: Ibrahim throws the veil away, uncle and nephew clasp hands, the barber plays and Ibrahim sings. THE END.

camera.notes: CAM: 160.4 from the S11 framing ease out to {x:500,y:650,zoom:1.0} by 163.0 (whole hall tableau); hold. THE END title in the upper wall area y 150..330, above every head.

scenes.composition: Tableau left to right: soldier in apron (x 120), wife (x 230), barber in yellow with lute (x 400), Ibrahim (x 560), Ma'mun (x 700), vizierBlue (x 880). Heads between y 600 and 660; title above.

actions.acting: Small settling moves, staggered; no one stands still as a statue.

actions.acting: A short laugh at it (lid 0.6, mouth open), then a big throw with anticipation.

subtitles.ar: خالف إبراهيم بن المهدي ابن أخيه الخليفة المأمون في أمر الحكم،|ثم خسر الصراع واضطر إلى الاختباء في بغداد.|أعلن المأمون جائزة ضخمة لمن يدل عليه،|فصار إبراهيم يخشى أن يعرفه أي عابر في الطريق.
subtitles.en: Ibrahim bin al-Mahdi opposed his nephew,|Caliph al-Ma’mun, in a struggle for power.|After losing, he hid in Baghdad,|fearing the large reward offered for his capture.

subtitles.ar: لجأ إبراهيم إلى حجّام،|فرحّب به وأطعمه،|لكن إبراهيم خاف أن يسلّمه طلبًا للجائزة.
subtitles.en: Ibrahim took refuge with a barber-surgeon.|The man welcomed him and fed him,|but Ibrahim feared that he might hand him over for the reward.

subtitles.ar: أخرج الحجّام عودًا وطلب من ضيفه الغناء،|ثم فاجأه بقوله إنه يعرف هويته وجائزة القبض عليه.|أكد أنه لن يخونه، وغنّى معه حتى خف خوف إبراهيم.|وحين عرض عليه مالًا لقاء مساعدته رفض أخذه.
subtitles.en: The barber produced a lute,|revealed that he knew Ibrahim’s identity,|and promised safety.|They sang together, and the host refused any payment for his help.

subtitles.ar: خرج إبراهيم متنكرًا بثياب امرأة،|فعرفه جندي وحاول القبض عليه.|دفعه إبراهيم قرب جسر وفرّ.
subtitles.en: Ibrahim went out disguised in women's clothing.|A soldier recognized him and tried to arrest him.|Ibrahim pushed him near a bridge and fled.

subtitles.ar: لجأ إبراهيم إلى امرأة فتحت له بيتها وأخفته،|ثم اكتشف أن الجندي المطارد زوجها.|مع ذلك واصلت حمايته ثلاثة أيام.|وبعد مغادرته قصد امرأة كان قد أعتقها قديمًا، لكنها طمعت في الجائزة وأبلغت عنه.
subtitles.en: A woman hid Ibrahim,|even though the injured pursuer was her husband.|After three days he moved to a former freedwoman’s house,|but she betrayed him for the reward.

subtitles.ar: أُحضر إبراهيم إلى المأمون وهو متنكر،|فاعترف بتمرده وطلب العفو.|انقسم الحاضرون بين من طالب بقتله ومن دعا إلى مسامحته.
subtitles.en: Ibrahim was brought before al-Ma'mun while still disguised.|He admitted his rebellion and asked for pardon.|Those present were divided between those who called for his death and those who urged mercy.

subtitles.ar: اختار الخليفة العفو عن عمه، وأعاد إليه أملاكه.|ثم طلب سماع تفاصيل أيام هروبه،|فعرف كيف ساعده الحجّام والمرأة، وكيف خانته المرأة المعتقة.|عندئذ قرر أن يكافئ الإحسان ويعاقب الخيانة.
subtitles.en: The caliph pardoned his uncle|and restored his property.|Hearing about the escape,|he learned who had sheltered Ibrahim and who had betrayed him.

subtitles.ar: عاقب المأمون المرأة التي دلّت على إبراهيم،|وجعل الجندي يتعلم مهنة الحجامة، وأكرم زوجته لذكائها.|أما الحجّام الكريم فأعطاه بيت الجندي|وكسوة شرف ومالًا سنويًا. وهكذا انتهت محنة إبراهيم بالعفو والجزاء.
subtitles.en: Al-Ma’mun punished the informer,|assigned the trooper to learn barbering, and honored the trooper’s wife.|He rewarded the loyal barber with the trooper’s house,|a robe, and an annual allowance.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (soldier)
new_assets.description: A soldier / guard / trooper preset for the person costume layer: pointed helmet with a nose bar and neck cloth, knee length tunic with a wide belt and a round chest plate (dot pattern as mail), boots; pal overrides for the tunic (red hero soldier, blue palace guards). Options: hold:'spear' (shaft 300, leaf blade), bandage:true (white band round the head with a knot, replaces or sits under the helmet), apron:true (white apron over the tunic), helmet:false.
new_assets.implementation: Add a COSTUME entry in Library/cast/people.js like the others: helmet = half ellipse + triangle spike + 6 px nose bar in the headwear slot; tunic uses the existing robe shape at knee length; belt = sash slot; chest plate = circle r 16 with a dot. Spear drawn like hold:'stick' with a blade. bandage and apron are small overlay draws after the body. Opt-in, so the regression test stays identical.

new_assets.name: cityBridge
new_assets.description: Street end with a low two-arch stone bridge over the Library river, open near edge for falls, far parapet, notice post, city silhouette (dimensions in sets).
new_assets.implementation: bake() a 1600 x 1230 canvas: sky(), a row of flat blue silhouettes (rects + half ellipses for domes), ground() to x 900, riverBank edge, river(c, t, {back:true}) and {front:true} drawn live around the deck; deck = K path with a quadratic top, two arch cut-outs with evenodd fill, stone joints as short lines; parapet as a parallel strip on the far side.

new_assets.name: oud
new_assets.description: Lute (see props): the story's emblem of trust, used in S4, S5, S11, S12.

new_assets.name: rewardPoster
new_assets.description: Reward notice with the wanted face and a coin pile (see props); appears in S2, S5, S6, S8.

new_assets.name: curtain, barberKit
new_assets.implementation: Curtain: 8 vertical stripes whose x positions are displaced by lift / bulge / gap functions; hem drawn last. barberKit: razor = two thin rects on a pivot; cup = half ellipse + rect lip with a white highlight.

new_assets.name: person faceCover

owner_questions: Opening picture for "opposed his nephew in the matter of rule": Ibrahim sits on the throne and is driven off it by Ma'mun and two guards (no fighting shown). Default: yes.

Real historical figures (Caliph al-Ma'mun, Ibrahim bin al-Mahdi) are drawn as the usual blocky comic people, and Ibrahim's face appears on a reward poster. Default: yes, as in the Library caliph preset.
Disguise comedy: his beard tip peeks from under the woman's veil and the court laughs (HA HA!) when the veil is lifted. Default: keep, gentle and brief.

The script says he pushed the soldier near a bridge; the plan has the soldier teeter and fall into the river with a SPLASH, then come home wet with a head bandage (the English calls him "the injured pursuer"). Default: keep the comic fall, no blood.
The call for his death is shown only as a sword picture in a vizier's balloon, the plea for mercy as a heart. Default: yes, no weapon is drawn in anyone's hand.
The informer's punishment is shown as the reward purse being taken back and her being led out in shame; no physical punishment is shown. Default: yes.
Added action: the barber tears up a reward notice to show "he would not betray him". Default: keep.
Her being a freed slave is shown as a broken chain and a scroll in a memory balloon. Default: keep; alternative is the scroll alone.

Invented English lettering: REWARD!, KNOCK!, TA-DA!, TWANG!, HALT!, SPLASH!, HA HA!, DAY 1 / 2 / 3, labels (IBRAHIM, THE UNCLE; CALIPH AL-MA'MUN; BARBER SURGEON; IBRAHIM?; SOLDIER; THE SAME SOLDIER!; HER HUSBAND!; UNCLE!; NEW JOB: BARBER; THE LOYAL BARBER; EVERY YEAR). Default: keep all.
Closing gag after the last word: the thrown veil lands on the soldier's head. Default: keep.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; cue every beat with w(p, n) from timing.json. The cue times in this plan are word starts from planning/inputs/timeline.md.

All people are the Library person with costume presets; give every figure a gaze target each frame (lookAt / gazePlan) and set LIFE.t = t for blinks. Use arm ANGLES (aL/aR) for poses that must read small (pointing, the shove, the teeter windmill) and hand targets (handLW/handRW) for contacts (lute, purse, veil, key).

Ibrahim keeps one seed and one scale (1.25 in rooms, 1.0 in the wide hall and street shots) through three costumes: merchant pal (0 to 23.3 and 120.3 on), lady + faceCover (61.2 to 120.3). Keep the green robe and yellow head cloth in all of them.
S3 to S5 are one continuous room scene (no cut): keep character positions continuous across the scene ids.

S6 timing is the centre of the comedy: shove on 70.16, teeter 71.62 to 73.5, Ibrahim gone by 73.4, soldier hits the water at 73.9 to 73.95 inside the 73.64 to 74.82 pause so the splash sound is clear of words.
S7: draw order door, soldier, wife, Ibrahim, then curtain, so the hidden man needs no clipped copy; the peeking eye is the same figure seen through the gap (clip to the gap rect).
The three-day counter (88.18 to 89.7) has only 1.5 s: cycle the window with skyCycle u from 0.1 to 3.1 with ease, counter ticks at 88.2, 89.15, 89.45.
Inset circle (S10): reuse drawBarberRoom / drawWifeRoom / drawStreet at fixed times (for example 49.6, 86.6, 97.2) rather than new drawings.

Sound effects only at: 23.0 whoosh, 26.8 knock, 60.6 chime, 73.95 splash, 140.5 clap pop, 166.5 chime. SND master 0.6. Everything else (strums, laughs) is silent lettering or picture only so no word is covered.
Panel-only shake (4 px, 0.2 s) at 70.16 and 73.95; never move the caption panel.
Lettering never covers a face: labels go beside heads with arrows; balloons sit in the upper wall area.
Subtitles: 3 or 4 chunks per paragraph as marked; the English is a condensed translation, so some English chunks are shorter than the Arabic they sit under.
warnings: Most of the film depends on planned assets that may not exist yet (palaceHall + throne, merchantHouse variant, marketStreet, faceCover, iconBalloon, inset circle, coinPile, purse, foodTray, splash). If they are not in Library when this film is built, build them in the story to the planned specifications and move them to Library after approval.
The person figure is front-facing only: the shove, the grab and the hand clasp must be staged side by side with arm angles and world hand targets; test these three poses in stills first.
The disguise must stay readable as Ibrahim at phone size: keep the green and yellow, and show the beard peek early (62.7).
P5 packs two houses and a three-day stay into 25 s, and P8 four judgments into 19 s: keep each to one clear picture and do not add extra business.
S10 is 24.6 s in one set: the inset circle and the costume wipe carry the visual change; do not let the two seated men sit still under it.
P8 English has no sentence for the Arabic closing line (وهكذا انتهت محنة إبراهيم بالعفو والجزاء); the last English chunk stays on screen under it.
Sensitive content softened by design: the death demand, the punishment and the freed-slave back story are shown as symbols only (see owner_questions).
